ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: nursed back to health
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been gentler with the sick since {OTHER} nursed {PAWN_objective} through {LABEL}.

plain.li: I'm on my feet again after {LABEL}. {OTHER_nameDef} sat up with me more nights than I can count.
{OTHER_nameDef} changed my dressings every day through {LABEL} and never once made me feel like a nuisance.
First day outside since {LABEL}. I went to find {OTHER_nameDef} before I did anything else.

warm.li: I wouldn't have come through {LABEL} without {OTHER_nameDef}. I want to be that for someone one day.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} kept me alive through {LABEL}. Noted. Owed.

cheerful.li: I survived {LABEL}, mostly out of spite, and partly because {OTHER_nameDef} wouldn't let me do otherwise.

gloomy.li: I came through {LABEL}. {OTHER_nameDef} made sure of it, though I'm not sure I'd have bothered.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s care through {LABEL} was competent and patient. I will remember it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: a kindness remembered
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has thought better of people since {OTHER}'s kindness on {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: a promise kept to them
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has taken the council at its word since it kept its promise on {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: forgiven
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been slower to judge others since {OTHER} forgave {PAWN_objective} for what {PAWN_pronoun} did on {LABEL}.

li.news: {OTHER_nameDef} has forgiven {PAWN_nameDef} for the breakdown on {LABEL}.

plain.li: I was sure {OTHER_nameDef} would never speak to me again after what I did on {LABEL}. Today {OTHER_pronoun} did, and kindly.
{OTHER_nameDef} told me to stop apologising for what happened on {LABEL}. I don't think I will, but it helped.
After what I did on {LABEL}, {OTHER_nameDef} brought me tea. Just tea. I nearly cried into it.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has forgiven me for what I did on {LABEL}. I'm going to try to deserve it.

blunt.li: I lost my head on {LABEL}. {OTHER_nameDef} let it go. I won't forget that.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} forgave me for the business on {LABEL}! I think. There was a hug, so I'm counting it.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} forgave me for what I did on {LABEL}, which is more than I've managed.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} chose not to hold what happened on {LABEL} against me. An unusual choice. I'll return it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: their secret betrayed
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has kept {PAWN_possessive} own counsel since {OTHER} gave away {PAWN_possessive} secret.

plain.li: I told {OTHER_nameDef} the one thing I'd never told anyone. Now everyone knows it.
{OTHER_nameDef} said it out loud, in company, like it was nothing. It was everything.
I keep going over the night I told {OTHER_nameDef}. I should have kept my mouth shut.

warm.li: I thought {OTHER_nameDef} cared about me. Maybe {OTHER_pronoun} does, and it slipped. It doesn't matter much now.

gloomy.li: Of course {OTHER_nameDef} told. People do. I knew that, and I told {OTHER_objective} anyway.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has shown what {OTHER_pronoun} is. I've adjusted accordingly.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: betrayed a confidence
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has had trouble meeting {OTHER}'s eyes since letting {OTHER}'s secret slip.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: lashed out
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has watched {PAWN_possessive} temper since lashing out on {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: lost the vote
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been touchy about the council since losing the vote to {OTHER}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: voted out of a seat
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been quieter at meetings since losing {PAWN_possessive} seat on {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: a promise the council broke
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has taken the council's word with a pinch of salt since it went back on it on {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: heartbroken
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been slow to let anyone close since {OTHER} broke {PAWN_possessive} heart.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are finished. I moved my things out of our room this evening. There weren't many.
I saw {OTHER_nameDef} at supper and turned straight round. I'll eat later.
It's over with {OTHER_nameDef}. Everyone is being very careful around me, which is worse.

warm.li: I gave {OTHER_nameDef} everything I had. I don't know if I have it to give again.

cheerful.li: Single again. I'm fine. I'm writing it down so it becomes true.

gloomy.li: I knew it wouldn't last with {OTHER_nameDef}. Nothing does. I just hoped.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has ended things. I'll spend the time on work. Work doesn't leave.
